def detector(L, conf_min_count=1):

    Xh=X/np.sqrt((X**2).mean(1,keepdims=True))
    mbar=Xh[~lab].mean(0)
    toks=np.array([i[2] for i in info])
    conf=['ĠHarvard','ĠBerkeley','ĠYale','ĠOxford','ĠStamford','ĠStanley','ĠStandard','Stan','ley','ford','ĠStan','Brad','ĠOil','ĠMIT','ĠPrinceton','ĠCambridge']
    C=[]
    for c in conf:
        m=(toks==c)&~lab
        if m.sum()>=conf_min_count: C.append(Xh[m].mean(0)-mbar)
    C=np.array(C); Q,_=np.linalg.qr(C.T)
    u=Xh[lab].mean(0)-mbar; u=u-Q@(Q.T@u)
    pr=(Xh-mbar)@u
    return u,mbar,pr,lab,info,Xh
